description: Crash reports filed under NHTSA's Standing General Order 2021-01 by automated driving system (ADS) and Level 2 driver assistance operators, 2021 to today, one row per report at its latest version, or one row per incident when grain is 'incident' (filings by several entities about one crash collapsed at the highest severity). Rows are the operators' own filings, not verified cases, and a filing does not establish fault.

crash.description: What the vehicle crashed with, e.g. Passenger Car, Pedestrian, Cyclist

entity.description: Reporting entity exactly as filed, e.g. Waymo LLC, Tesla, Zoox

program.description: ADS = driverless, ADAS = Level 2 driver assistance

q.description: Text in narrative, city, report ID, make or model

severity.description: Highest injury severity alleged, e.g. Fatality, Serious, Minor, No Injuries Reported, Unknown

name: search_nhtsa_sgo
title: Search NHTSA SGO crash reports
